# Approved GitHub Action pins.
#
# One row per external action used by .github/workflows:
#
#   <owner>/<repo>[/<path>]@<40-hex commit sha> <version>
#
# The workflow policy tests in .sparkwing/jobs require every `uses:` to
# appear here with the same version its `# vX.Y.Z` comment claims, and
# require every row here to be used by a workflow. A changed SHA, a
# renamed owner, or a fork therefore fails the gate until this table is
# updated on purpose. Nothing in the gate reaches the network.
#
# To update a pin:
#   1. Resolve the tag you intend to run:
#        gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/git/ref/tags/<version>
#      An annotated tag answers with `object.type: tag`; follow
#      `object.url` and read `object.sha` for the commit.
#   2. Read the release notes for the change you are adopting.
#   3. Edit the workflow line and the row below in the same commit.
#   4. Delete rows whose action no longer appears in any workflow.
#
# Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) proposes these updates weekly. It
# rewrites the workflow line and its comment but not this table, so a
# Dependabot pull request fails the gate until the row is updated too.
